key_insight: MS-Exam-Gen is a reproducible, source-grounded pipeline for building and auditing multiple-choice benchmarks to test LLM knowledge of multiple sclerosis MRI concepts.
clinical_relevance: It helps evaluate whether medical LLMs can answer narrow, evolving MS-MRI knowledge questions reliably, which matters for safe use in clinical knowledge support.
method: Indexed 66 expert sources into 4,289 retrieval chunks.
Generated and locked a 3,058-item MCQ candidate benchmark across 16 topics and 53 subtopics.
Used automated quality audits, consistency screening, and empirical calibration to reduce answer cues and test robustness.
evidence_signal: Across 12 LLM endpoints, the benchmark produced 36,696 item-level predictions with performance ranging from 89.7% to 46.9%, a 42.8-point spread.
watch_item: The benchmark is not clinically certified and still lacks expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing, so results should be treated as candidate-benchmark evidence rather than a final exam standard.
paper_title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
